primary_local_question: Does the current method outperform the baseline on the smallest credible benchmark?
why_now: The main evidence campaign is blocked by the absence of a credible comparison.

working_set.combination_rationale: This is the first empirical trial.

minimum_useful_output: A completed comparison or a diagnosed failure with reusable logs.
success_conditions: Baseline and method run under the same metric.
stop_conditions: Metric cannot be resolved from inspected sources.
must_not_do: Do not expand into ablations before the main signal is known.

resource_scout.reason: All required resources are already inspected locally.

expected_human_outcome: The human can see whether the main signal exists.
